codeReview.summary: The rerun fully addresses the prior blocking issue from `fix-goal-card-frame-under-narrowing`. In `renderGoals`, goal-card interactivity now depends solely on whether the active subset still has rows (`isInteractive = isScopable`), so a previously scoped card correctly becomes non-interactive once filters/search narrow that scoped subset to zero rows while the dedicated scope-dismiss controls remain available. I did not identify any new blocking correctness regressions in the touched goal-card path or its added regression coverage.
